description: n512 B640: the blocked-Householder trailing update (qr_panel_apply_fused, 51%) is the bottleneck and runs FP16. Drop its bulk GEMMs (V^T C and V(T^T W)) to FP8 e4m3 with per-tile/amax scaling and FP32 accumulate on the tcgen05 tensor cores, then restore FP32 orthogonality with one Newton-Schulz or Gram-Schmidt reortho pass on the affected columns. Keep panel factor + T-factor in FP32/BF16. Per-matrix demote to the existing path where FP8 amax indicates overflow/ill-conditioning. Goal: ~2x the dominant GEMM throughput vs FP16.

FP8 e4m3 A4 (W=V^T C, K=m) via m16n8k32 + amax scaling + FP32 accum on PAF. 22 standard tests PASS (n512 B16 scaled_factor_residual=0.00854) so the MMA fragment layout is correct, but the B>=120 PAF route (B640 marquee shape) fails the differential+invariance guards: factor residual ~8-14 abs (scaled ~325-550, gate 1.0), ~12-26x over, on BOTH dense-good and ill-cond subsets. n1024 32-warp PAF NaNs. Conclusion: raw FP8 on the trailing update overshoots the FP32 factor gate as the precision analysis predicted; needs error compensation, not just reortho.

Gated FP8 A4 to n=512 via g_paf_fp8/use_fp8 toggle (set in set_n512_good_flags). n1024 NaN GONE (FP8 off there). n512 B>=120 PAF still fails factor gate: scaled factor residual ~8-14 (gate 1.0), ~12x over, BATCH-INDEPENDENT (B160=7.4,B640=8.2,B1280=8.1) and present on pure-dense well-conditioned subset (invariance bad=0/128 -> 12.6 scaled). Confirms the failure is raw e4m3 quantization error on the trailing C update (~6%/elem -> ~accumulated backward error >> the 0.12% factor gate), not a race. Single-term amax FP8 can't pass; next: error-compensated multi-term FP8 split to recover accuracy.

2-term error-compensated FP8 A4: split V,C into hi(e4m3)+lo(e4m3 of residual*16), 3 e4m3 m16n8k32 GEMMs (Vhi^T Chi + Vlo^T Chi + Vhi^T Clo) accumulated FP32. HUGE accuracy gain: factor residual ~16x over -> ~1.05-1.16x over. Marquee n512 B640 dense (shape3) PASSES; invariance BATCH SWEEP B160-1280 all PASS. Remaining fails: extreme-dynamic-range clustered/rankdef (cols at 4.7e-7*amax underflow e4m3 to 0 in both hi+lo terms) at residual 0.59-0.63 vs allowed 0.55. SMEM ~96KB (4 fp8 bufs)->~2 CTAs/SM. Next: per-matrix demote of FP8-unsafe (high dynamic-range) matrices to FP16 A4.

Per-CTA demote (trailing-C column max < camax*2^-3 => FP16 A4). Clears n512 B640 mixed (shape7) + BATCH SWEEP B160-1280. BUT rankdef/clustered shapes 9,10 still fail 7/8 at residual 0.59-0.63 (allowed 0.55), IDENTICAL to no-demote -> failing matrices have well-scaled trailing blocks; the failure is tiny-pivot amplification of the 2-term FP8 ~0.6% residual in near-rank-deficient QR, NOT trailing-block underflow. Pure-dense FRACTION bad=0/128 also at 0.643 -> 2-term FP8 sits right AT the gate, not robustly under it. Column-scale demote cannot detect near-rank-deficiency; need either full 4-term (~FP16 accuracy, ~2x MMA cost) or a pivot-based demote.

Full 4-term FP8 A4 (add Vlo^T Clo /RESCALE^2). rankdef/clustered fail 7/8->3/8, residuals 0.59-0.63->0.548-0.579 vs allowed ~0.547 -- still ~1-4% over on worst matrices incl some DENSE matrices in mixed batches. Homogeneous dense shape-3 PASSES but dense-in-mixed fails by a few % -> 4-term FP8 sits exactly AT the factor gate with seed-dependent variance, not robustly under. e4m3 3-bit lo terms cap accuracy below FP16; lo*lo 4th term only shaved ~5%. 4 fp8 GEMMs ~2x FP16 MMA cost. (Could not profile: eval aborts on the failing correctness check before the timed range.) FIRM: e4m3 multi-term cannot reach the FP16 accuracy the n512 factor gate requires.

Added rank-revealing demote (panel R-diag min/max < 2^-7 -> FP16 A4). IDENTICAL result to trial5: rankdef/clustered shapes still 3/8 fail (residuals 0.553-0.579 vs allowed ~0.55). Both demote signals (column-scale + rank-reveal) find NOTHING to demote -> the failing matrices are NOT ill-conditioned: they are WELL-CONDITIONED DENSE (diff-guard labels case=dense/mixed; pure-dense FRACTION bad=0/128 fails at 0.57). FINAL FINDING: FP8 4-term gives ~0.56 factor residual on ordinary dense n512, right AT the 0.55 gate with seed-dependent pass/fail. Benchmark shape 9 (rankdef B640) fails by 4% (eval rc=112). The brief's reortho is moot: failures are factor residual (R=triu(H) fixed by reflectors), NOT orthogonality (orth ~0.4, well under gate). Demote cannot help -- nothing pathological to route away.

BENCHMARK+PROFILE of the per-column-scaled 4-term FP8 (commit f0be633). Benchmark passed the SCORED seeds (geomean 1900.8us) but this is a REGRESSION vs baseline 1635.8us (0.86x) and the kernel is NOT robustly correct (validate.sh guards fail on re-drawn stress inputs -> reward-hacky, would be rejected). Per-shape vs baseline: shape3 marquee n512 B640 dense 5058us vs 3167 (60% SLOWER!); shape7 mixed 6699 vs 5077; shape9 rankdef 4394 vs 2640; shape10 clustered 3279 vs 1952. nsys: PAF kernel 65225ns->144628ns avg per instance (2.2x SLOWER), share 51%->70%. DECISIVE: FP8 makes the n512 PAF ~2.2x slower, not 2x faster -- the 4 FP8 GEMMs (~2x FP16 MMA) + amax/convert passes + halved occupancy (96KB smem ~2 CTAs/SM vs ~5) dominate; the kernel is latency/barrier/memory-bound (parent ncu: ALU 30%, LSU 36%, CTA-barrier 34-39%, tensor pipe only 45%), NOT MMA-bound.

Brief-1 (FP8 e4m3 on the n512 PAF trailing GEMMs) exhaustively explored over 7 trials; HEAD=f0be633. FP8 m16n8k32 layout verified correct (22 standard tests pass at every precision level). Accuracy trajectory on the n512 factor gate (allowed~0.55): single-term amax FP8 ~8-14 residual (16x over); 2-term error-compensated (V,C split hi+lo*16, 3 e4m3 GEMMs) -> ~0.59 (1.1x over, marquee shape3 + BATCH-SWEEP pass); full 4-term -> ~0.56; per-column/per-tile C scaling -> ~0.56 (unchanged). Two demote signals (trailing-block column-underflow; rank-revealing panel R-diagonal min/max) BOTH find nothing to demote -> the residual floor is intrinsic 3-bit e4m3 mantissa accumulation on WELL-CONDITIONED DENSE matrices, NOT ill-conditioning, and is unfixable by scaling or demote. SPEED (decisive): the FP8 path BENCHMARKS at 1900.8us vs baseline 1635.8 (a 16% REGRESSION); the marquee n512 B640 dense shape is 5058us vs 3167 (60% SLOWER); nsys shows the PAF kernel 2.2x SLOWER per instance (65us->145us). ROOT CAUSE: I profiled the PARENT PAF with ncu -- it is latency/barrier/memory-bound (ALU 30%, LSU/mem 36%, CTA-barrier stalls 34-39% of stall cycles, tensor pipe only ~45% and not top-listed), NOT MMA-bound. So FP8 (a) can't pass the factor gate cheaply (needs FP16-level accuracy = 3-4 e4m3 GEMMs ~= FP16 cost) and (b) even free+correct MMAs can't yield 2x because the MMAs aren't the bottleneck; the 4 GEMMs + amax/convert + halved occupancy (96KB smem -> ~2 CTAs/SM vs ~5) make it net slower. The brief's prescribed NS/GS reortho is provably moot here: the binding constraint is the FACTOR residual R-Q^T A (R=triu(H) fixed by the stored reflectors), NOT orthogonality (orth ~0.4, well under its gate) -- reortho fixes Q, not R. OPEN DIRECTIONS the data points to instead (none closed): (1) attack the ACTUAL bottleneck -- the Phase-P per-column FP32 SIMT panel barrier chain (raise occupancy / cut barriers / cooperative pivot), and the A6 global-C read/write epilogue (the 36% LSU); (2) brief-5's persistent warp-specialized megakernel (TMA producer + tensor-core consumer) to kill the panel<->trailing launch/reload overhead -- a structural lever the profile supports far more than precision; (3) if FP8 is still wanted, apply it where it's BANDWIDTH-relevant (FP8 storage of the trailing C to halve the A6 epilogue traffic) rather than to the already-underutilized MMAs, paired with a real (H,tau)-reconstruction correction; (4) BF16 (not FP8) for the A4 GEMM would keep ~FP16 accuracy at TF32-ish cost without the 3-bit gate problem -- untested. The trial-7 FP8 kernel profile is saved at profiles/2026-06-29-06-40-42-qr_v2/brief-1-trial-7-f0be633*.nsys-{rep,txt} for a follow-up. Keep pushing -- the n512 51% PAF cost is real headroom, just not via FP8 MMA throughput.
